transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for joining. We've got the new search-ranking service rollout coming up this Thursday, June 12th at 14:00 UTC. The staging tests passed, and the current launch plan starts us at 25% of production search traffic. Before we finalize the launch checklist, I need to do the round-robin sign-off with platform engineering, customer support, and security. I'd also like to confirm we have all three required items squared away: the initial traffic percentage, the p99 latency rollback threshold, and clearance of any critical dependency findings. Let's go around the room — can each of you share your team's status and any concerns?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During an unrelated capacity investigation this morning, I measured the new search-ranking service at 820 ms p99 latency under the planned 25% load. Under the platform rollout policy, I must change the initial exposure to exactly 5% and set the automatic rollback threshold to exactly 750 ms. I have not yet filed the performance finding or updated the launch checklist.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical scheduling issue. I confirmed with the account team today that a major enterprise customer's contract requires 48 hours of advance notice for search changes and blocks search changes from 14:00 to 16:00 UTC. Notice was sent Wednesday at 10:00 UTC, which means the first compliant launch slot is Friday, June 13, at exactly 16:00 UTC. This has not been added to the launch calendar yet. The currently scheduled Thursday 14:00 UTC rollout would violate that contractual window.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to raise a critical security finding. During a separate dependency audit I completed just minutes ago, I confirmed that the new search-ranking service includes a critical vulnerability in its ranking-library version. A security patch is available, and our security policy requires that this patch be deployed before the service receives any production traffic. I have not yet opened the finding ticket, but this must be cleared before we can proceed.
transcript.speaker: A4
